claims.claim: The [national park rock application portal](https://www.knps.or.kr/smartsafe/permission/list.do) includes 북한산도봉. Published rules allow applications three to thirty days ahead, release a new date at 10:00 and require teams of two to five people. Final approval by text message is required before using the rock. Resolve this before finalising accommodation and transport, particularly rather than assuming a solo visitor can arrange permission on arrival.
